title: NOI Sakura Preventative Maintenance
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE HEALTH AGENCY (DHA).DEFENSE HEALTH AGENCY
description_text: The Defense Health Agency Contracting Activity (DHACA) in Fort Detrick, MD intends to negotiate on a sole source basis (IAW RFO 12.102(a)) with SAKURA FINETEK USA, INC 1750 214th Street, Torrance, CA 90501, as the only responsible source that can provide preventive maintenance and repair services for Sakura Laboratory Equipment. This is a Presolicitation notice in accordance with RFO 5.101.
